name: counter
title: A shared counter
summary: Every worker increments one shared counter, with a plain increment, an atomic one, two atomic halves, or one loop the compiler folds, and the page compares what the counter holds with what it should.

controls.name: operation
controls.label: Operation
controls.hint: plain: counter++. atomic: one atomic add. split: an atomic load, then an atomic store. folded: a loop the compiler sees whole.

results.name: observed
results.label: Observed
results.what: the counter after the last worker finished

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of each worker's load, add and store, interleaved by a schedule you choose
